sources.locator: Section 11.2.1 and Figure 11.5 describe the spatial linear-filter stage as a weighted stimulus projection, before a nonlinearity and a stochastic spike model. This lesson isolates that algebraic stage in an original five-site construction; it does not reproduce a receptive-field measurement, figure or LNP spike model.
